title: Unit Converter
description: *Unit Converter* is a **one-box web tool**. Type `100 km`, `5'10"`, `1 1/2 cup` or `100 USD` and every unit it can be appears at once, so there is no category to pick and no second dropdown.
I set the usability bar: the source unit alone decides the category, and the answers are ordered by **how useful each number is**, not just how common the unit is.
It covers **17 kinds of measurement and 59 currencies**, with **live exchange rates** and an offline copy when they fail. The conversions are **covered by tests written before the code**.
